rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a telltale clue that makes something apparent.

example.english: His constant looks at the door were a giveaway that he was nervous.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢時不停望住個門口，呢個就係佢心虛嘅線索。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 si4 bat1 ting4 mong6 zyu6 go3 mun4 hau2 ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 keoi5 sam1 heoi1 ge3 sin3 sok3

rows.note: Use this for a free item, especially a promotional item included with a purchase or service.

example.english: You get a cup as a giveaway when you buy this appliance.
example.traditional: 買呢部電器仲有一隻杯做贈品。
example.jyutping: maai5 ne1 bou6 din6 hei3 zung6 jau5 jat1 zek3 bui1 zou6 zang6 ban2

rows.note: Use this specifically for an event organized to distribute free items.

example.english: The mall is holding a giveaway event today, with a singer performing.
example.traditional: 商場今日搞派贈品活動，仲有歌手表演。
example.jyutping: soeng1 coeng4 gam1 jat6 gaau2 paai3 zang6 ban2 wut6 dung6 zung6 jau5 go1 sau2 biu2 jin2
